title: A sequential checkout dependency budget
method: Synthetic sequential timeout allocation totaling 200 milliseconds. Values are design allowances, not latency percentiles or benchmark observations. Network overhead and local work need their own budget, and parallel branches use critical-path analysis.
alt: A sequential checkout dependency budget: Inventory allowance 40 milliseconds, Pricing allowance 60 milliseconds, Payment allowance 80 milliseconds, Order-write allowance 20 milliseconds. Illustrative inputs.
